description: Any Google Slides API batchUpdate: slides (create, duplicate, reorder, delete, background), shapes, text boxes, images (by URL, or local files through `images`), videos, lines, tables (rows, columns, merges, cell and border styles), Sheets charts, text and its styles, bullets, replace all text or shapes with images, transforms, z-order, alt text and the rest. One atomic batch, checked against the API's schema before anything is sent. Ids you choose for new objects (5 to 50 characters, starting with a letter or _) can be referred to by later requests in the same batch. expected_revision (from get_presentation) refuses the batch if the deck changed. Returns the new revisionId and the replies that carry ids, by request position.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

expected_revision.description: The revisionId these requests were computed from; the batch is refused if the deck is no longer at it.

content_base64.description: Instead of path, from a script only: never typed. Needs sha256.

path.description: The image file, in the server's file roots (where upload_file reads).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source: required with content_base64, checked with path.

images.description: Local PNG, JPEG or GIF images by name; use "image:<name>" as the image URL in a request (insertInlineImage.uri, createImage.url, replaceImage, replaceAllShapesWithImage.imageUrl). Each is uploaded to Drive, shared by link only while the batch runs, then unshared and trashed.

presentation_id.description: The presentation's id, or its URL.

requests.description: slides batchUpdate requests, applied in order, all or none: each an object with ONE request kind, e.g. {"createSlide": {"objectId": "slide_intro", "slideLayoutReference": {"predefinedLayout": "TITLE_AND_BODY"}}}. Kinds: deleteComment, deleteTableRow, unmergeTableCells, createLine, insertComment, updatePageElementsZOrder, updateTextStyle, rerouteLine, insertTableRows, duplicateObject, mergeTableCells, updatePageElementAltText, createImage, createSlide, replaceImage, createSheetsChart, insertTableColumns, updateImageProperties, updateVideoProperties, replaceAllText, deleteObject, deleteParagraphBullets, updateParagraphStyle, ungroupObjects, updateSlidesPosition, updatePageElementTransform, updateSlideProperties, updateShapeProperties, addCommentReply, createVideo, replaceAllShapesWithImage, deleteTableColumn, updateTableCellProperties, createParagraphBullets, updatePageProperties, deleteCommentReply, updateLineProperties, deleteText, updateLineCategory, groupObjects, replaceAllShapesWithSheetsChart, insertText, refreshSheetsChart, updateTableBorderProperties, createTable, createShape, updateTableRowProperties, updateTableColumnProperties, updateCommentPost. editors_api_reference names each kind's fields.

name: batch_update_presentation
title: Apply Slides API requests
